title: echinochloa crus-galli var. stolonifera
intro: Echinochloa crus-galli var. stolonifera, commonly known as barnyard grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in barnyard grass include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of consuming barnyard grass include lowering cholesterol levels, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system.
